manifest.output_protocol: Return one JSON object with exactly ClientA.dfy and ClientB.dfy, each containing the COMPLETE file as a string. Preserve every byte outside the empty proof bodies. Only proof bodies may change. Allowed statements: F.Case0A/Case1A/Case0B/Case1B(integer_expression); and if comparison { statements } with optional else/else if. Integer expressions: x, y, decimal integers, unary +/- and binary +/- with arithmetic parentheses. Comparisons: < <= > >= == !=. No parentheses around a whole comparison. No comments, assertions, assumptions, reveals, loops, declarations or other calls. Only exported names can verify. At most 64 statements and 2048 tokens per body; nesting 24.
